name: CAMS 3257W
title: Ancient Greek Philosophy
description: (Also offered as PHIL 2221W.) Greek philosophy from its origin in the Pre-Socratics through its influence on early Christianity. Readings from the works of Plato and Aristotle. May include related ancient philosophical traditions.
requirement_description: One three-credit course in Philosophy at the 1100 level; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
